items.title: ethresear.ch：通过固定存储押金与动态退款进行经济化的状态管理
items.note: 16:59：新建状态需锁定固定 ETH 押金，以放弃的质押收益作为隐性租金；删除状态时由协议按需提供动态退款，作为“状态恒温器”。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Economic State Management via Fixed Storage Bonds and Dynamic Refunds
items.note_en: 16:59: creating new state locks a fixed ETH bond, with forgone staking yield acting as implicit rent; deleting state earns a dynamic protocol funded refund that works as a "state thermostat".
